# T6.2 (TASKS.md) -- DESIGN.md §3 degenerate-case table, row "No eligible
# heir (all unstable/lagging)", rewritten for DESIGN_UPDATE.md D5/D6
# (2026-09-28). The v1 version made every follower fail max-heir-lag; that
# bound is gone, and D5 measures freshness against the freshest follower,
# so equally-behind followers are all in sync.
#
# Here a heir is selected normally, then every follower goes silent (all
# messages to them dropped). With ElectionTick=3 and the default
# heir-sync-grace (= ElectionTick), a follower is in sync while its last
# ack is at most 3 ticks old, and the heir is dropped once it has been out
# of sync for 3 more ticks: at ack age 6. Nobody else is in sync either, so
# the leader has no heir and every node falls back to stock timers (D3).
# After the partition heals, a heir comes back only after the D5 warm-up
# (3 of 5 in-sync samples).

log-level error
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 heir-election=true stability-score=50
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 heir-election=true stability-score=255
----
ok

----
ok
